clips.title: The story
paras: The Venture Co. Letters are internal correspondence recovered from Windshear Mine in Stonetalon Mountains. Stolen under the cover of explosive distractions, they provide the night elf Sentinels with crucial intelligence on goblin industrial operations in the region.

Windshear Crag has been overrun by the Venture Company, whose logging machines and strip-mining operations tear through the ancient woodland. To uncover the full scope of the cartel's ambitions, Alliance operatives deployed covert sabotage to create distractions and infiltrate Windshear Mine. These retrieved letters contain private communications and logistical records detailing the company's local activities, giving Sentinel leadership insight into how the defilers organize their workforce and supply lines.
